brief: Publications for Entero Therapeutics (formerly First Wave BioPharma and AzurRx BioPharma) stopped phase 2 trials: NCT04858425 (niclosamide), NCT04839575 and NCT04243551 (latiglutenase), NCT04542434 and NCT04436458. For each, was a paper reporting its results published?

findings.claim: No results publication found for NCT04542434 (niclosamide); 3 articles mention the trial.
findings.notes: Snapshot and live PubMed/Europe PMC searched; only mention_only items found.

findings.claim: No results publication found for NCT04858425 (niclosamide); 3 articles mention the trial.
findings.notes: Snapshot and live PubMed/Europe PMC searched; only mention_only items found.

findings.claim: No results publication found for NCT04436458 (niclosamide); 5 articles mention the trial.
findings.notes: Snapshot and live PubMed/Europe PMC searched; only mention_only items found.

findings.claim: No results publication found for NCT04839575 (latiglutenase); 4 articles mention the trial.
findings.notes: Snapshot and live PubMed/Europe PMC searched; only mention_only items found.

findings.claim: No results publication found for NCT04243551 (latiglutenase); 5 articles mention the trial.
findings.notes: Snapshot and live PubMed/Europe PMC searched; only mention_only items found.

args.sql: SELECT nct_id, interventions, drug_names FROM trials WHERE nct_id IN ('NCT04858425', 'NCT04839575', 'NCT04243551', 'NCT04542434', 'NCT04436458')
